def build(pre, ino):
    if not pre: return None
    idx = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(ino)}
    def rec(pl, pr, il, ir):
        if pl > pr: return None
        root = TreeNode(pre[pl])
        i = idx[pre[pl]]
        left_size = i - il
        root.left = rec(pl + 1, pl + left_size, il, i - 1)
        root.right = rec(pl + left_size + 1, pr, i + 1, ir)
        return root
    return rec(0, len(pre) - 1, 0, len(ino) - 1)
